description: Source file implementing trust store logic for macOS, including trust evaluation, caching, and keychain event handling within the Chromium project.

classes.name: TrustStoreMac
classes.description: Manages trust evaluation for certificates on macOS, including caching and reacting to keychain events.

classes.name: TrustImpl
classes.description: Abstract interface for trust evaluation implementations.

classes.name: TrustImplDomainCacheFullCerts
classes.description: Caches full certificates and trust status per trust domain, using SecTrustSettingsCopyCertificates.

classes.name: TrustImplKeychainCacheFullCerts
classes.description: Caches certificates from keychain and their trust status, using SecItemCopyMatching.

classes.name: TrustImplNoCache
classes.description: Trust implementation that calls SecTrustSettingsCopyTrustSettings on each check without caching.

classes.name: ResultDebugData
classes.description: Holds debug information about trust evaluation results.

methods.name: IsTrustDictionaryTrustedForPolicy
methods.description: Determines trust status from a trust settings dictionary for a specific policy.

methods.name: IsTrustSettingsTrustedForPolicy
methods.description: Evaluates trust settings array for a certificate to determine trust status.

methods.name: IsSecCertificateTrustedForPolicyInDomain
methods.description: Checks trust settings for a certificate in a specific trust domain.

methods.name: IsCertificateTrustedForPolicy
methods.description: Determines trust status for a parsed certificate for a specific policy.

methods.name: UpdateUserData
methods.description: Updates debug info in user data.

methods.name: IsNotAcceptableIntermediate
methods.description: Filters out certificates that cannot be valid intermediates for a given policy.

methods.name: CalculateFingerprint256
methods.description: Computes SHA-256 fingerprint of a certificate.

methods.name: GetMacNormalizedIssuer
methods.description: Retrieves normalized issuer data for a certificate.

methods.name: FindMatchingCertificatesForMacNormalizedSubject
methods.description: Finds certificates matching a normalized subject data.
